title: Dial Surf
summary: Johnny cannot sleep, so V takes the pocket radio onto the balcony and judges the city's stations with him.

start.bringUp: You cannot sleep and V's body is awake anyway. Bring up, in your own way and grumpy, that V should go out on the balcony with the little radio and turn it on, because you want to know if any station still plays something you would admit to.

balcony.name: the balcony of V's flat in Megabuilding H10, Kabuki

SH2.open.01.text: You're awake. So am I. Unfortunately we share the lights.

SH2.open.02.text: Go out on the balcony. Take the little radio. I want to hear what they play now.

SH2.open.03.text: Fine view. Shame about the neighbours. Turn it on.

SH2.stage.quiet.01.text: Now turn it off. Just the city. That's the real rhythm section.

SH2.close.01.text: Night before a show was always this quiet. Then the noise came and it was the best thing in the world.

SH2.close.02.text: Alt hated silence. Said it had no edges. Anyway. Go to bed.

SH2.close.03.text: Whatever's chewing you, sleep on it. It'll look smaller. It won't, but it's polite.

SH2.sent.caption.text: Turn it up. No, off. Leave it.

g1.asks: Do you ever just listen? Not to people. To the noise?
g1.know: V is on the balcony of the H10 flat with the pocket radio. The radio is for judging songs, you cannot sleep, and V can change stations freely.
g1.secret: You have not heard a song you did not write or sneer at in years, and you miss it.
g1.wants: V to start the dial and say what V would defend.

g2.asks: What's the first thing you hear when it's quiet? Be honest.
g2.know: Ten minutes of quiet and the radio is off. You mention Alt in two sentences at most.
g2.secret: Alt's name, and that the quiet reminds you of the night before a show.

stages.label: Johnny asks V to go out on the balcony
stages.know: It is late and you cannot sleep. You want V to take the little radio out on the balcony and turn it on, grumpy and a little embarrassed to ask.
stages.wants: V to agree to go out on the balcony with the radio.

choices.means: V agrees to go out on the balcony and turn the radio on

stages.label: Judge the radio from the balcony
stages.know: V is on the balcony of the Megabuilding H10 flat with the pocket radio on. You judge every station and song V passes, and you want to hear what V would stand behind.
stages.wants: V to keep the radio on the balcony and say what V hears.

stages.label: Johnny asks what V would defend
stages.know: You have heard V judge the radio from the balcony. You ask V to leave it on the one thing V would defend, and you want to know why.
stages.wants: V to name the one thing V would defend, or to say it is only noise.

choices.means: V names the song or station V would defend, and why
V says it is only noise

stages.label: Switch the radio off and listen to the city
stages.know: The radio is off and you want V to listen to the city for ten minutes. You talk about the dead quiet of the night before a show and, for the first time, you mention Alt, in two sentences.
stages.wants: V to sit still on the balcony and listen.

quiet.memory: On a night V could not sleep, you made V go out on the balcony and judge the radio together, and you did not say what you were listening for.
quiet.history: Johnny now comments on the radio in V's cars and calls it the dial surf.

quiet-worry.memory: You went out on the balcony with Johnny and told him what was keeping you awake.

later.memory: You told Johnny not now, and he said the offer stands.

left.memory: You went in from the balcony before Johnny was done judging the radio.
